name: Leil Viva 120 1-Person Outdoor Sauna Kit
description: Leil Viva 120 1-Person Outdoor Sauna Kit Features Premium 40mm ThermoWood® Construction : Durable thermally-treated Scandinavian pine resists moisture, warping, and swelling for year-round outdoor durability and exceptional thermal performance. Compact 1-Person Design : Perfectly sized at 48.2" W × 53.5" D × 92.1" H for seamless integration into small patios, decks, or tight backyard spaces without sacrificing comfort or authentic sauna experience. Authentic Estonian Leil Steam Experience : Three strategically-engineered ventilation openings create balanced airflow and soft, gentle heat that defines true Nordic sauna culture with deep, enveloping warmth. Modern Nordic Aesthetic : Vertical bar front wall, warm interior tones, and bronze-tinted tempered glass door deliver refined Scandinavian design that enhances any outdoor living space. Thermo-Alder Interior Comfort : Smooth bench and backrest constructed from thermo-alder—a low-thermal-conductivity wood that stays cool to the touch even at high temperatures for extended relaxation sessions. Weather-Resistant EPDM Roof Cover : Sealed ceiling with premium EPDM rubber provides complete protection against moisture and harsh elements, ensuring lasting performance in all climates. Intuitive Modular Assembly : Pre-fabricated wall elements and intelligent layout make DIY installation smooth and straightforward—most users can complete assembly in one day with basic tools and minimal assistance. Heavy-Duty Tempered Bronze Glass Door : Premium-grade tempered glass with sophisticated bronze tint, premium handle, and black hinges combines durability with elegant design while offering enhanced privacy. Flexible Heating Options : Compatible with electric heaters (4.5–6kW recommended) allowing you to choose between convenient electric systems or optional wood-burning experiences for authentic leil sessions. Customization Ready : Easily upgrade with optional LED lighting systems (under-bench or behind-backrest) and decorative hexagon back-wall panels to personalize your wellness retreat. Red Dot Best of the Best Design Award : Recognized for exceptional design quality and practical performance by international design juries, reflecting Leil's commitment to form and function. Two-Year Comprehensive Warranty : Full coverage for manufacturing defects and pre-transportation damage, providing peace of mind in your investment with responsive claim support from Leil. Leil Viva 120 1-Person Outdoor Sauna Kit Specs Capacity 1 person External Dimensions (Width) 48.2 inches External Dimensions (Depth) 53.5 inches External Dimensions (Height) 92.1 inches Internal Dimensions (Width) 44.9 inches Internal Dimensions (Depth) 44.9 inches Internal Dimensions (Height) 82.7 inches Steam Room Volume 2.7 m³ (95.3 cubic feet) Coverage Area 17.2 square feet Weight Approximately 882 lbs Wall Construction 40mm ThermoWood® (thermally-treated Scandinavian pine) Flooring 40mm ThermoWood® Ceiling/Roof 40mm ThermoWood® with EPDM roof cover for weather resistance Bench/Backrest Material Thermo-alder (low thermal conductivity, stays cool to touch) Door Material Tempered bronze glass with premium handle and black hinges Ventilation System 3 strategically-placed openings for optimal air circulation and heat balance Heater Compatibility Electric heaters only (4.5–6kW recommended, sold separately) Electrical Requirements 220–240V hardwired connection with dedicated breaker (varies by heater model) Assembly Type DIY modular kit (not pre-assembled, includes hardware and manual) Installation Surface Stable, level ground such as concrete pad, paver patio, or reinforced deck Warranty Period 2 years covering manufacturing defects and pre-transportation damage Included Components 40mm ThermoWood® walls, thermo-alder bench/backrest, tempered glass door, ThermoWood® floor, EPDM-protected roof, adjustable leveling feet, hardware, installation manual Optional Upgrades LED lighting sets (under-bench or behind-backrest), decorative hexagon back-wall panels Maintenance Recommended Annual treatment with UV-protective varnish (exterior) and sauna oil/wax (benches) Year-Round Use Yes, engineered for cold winters and hot summers with complete moisture protection Leil Viva 120 1-Person Outdoor Sauna Kit FAQ What is ThermoWood® and why is it ideal for saunas? ThermoWood® is thermally-modified Scandinavian pine that has been heat-treated using only heat and steam—no chemical additives. This process removes natural resins and moisture, making it exceptionally resistant to water, humidity, warping, swelling, rot, and insect damage. Unlike untreated cedar or hemlock, ThermoWood® provides superior dimensional stability and insulation, maintaining its integrity through years of high-heat sauna cycles. It's the premium choice for outdoor saunas requiring durability in all weather conditions. Can the Viva 120 be used year-round, and what weather protection does it provide? Yes, the Viva 120 is fully engineered for year-round outdoor use in all climates. The 40mm thick ThermoWood® construction provides exceptional thermal insulation and moisture resistance. The ceiling features an EPDM rubber roof cover that seals out rain, snow, and harsh UV exposure. We recommend applying an external UV-protective varnish treatment annually to maintain color and extend durability. The sauna will endure cold winters and hot summers while maintaining structural integrity and performance. How difficult is assembly, and what tools or expertise do I need? The Viva 120 features pre-fabricated modular panels that make assembly straightforward compared to traditional barrel-stave construction. Most users can complete assembly in a single day with two people and basic tools. Detailed assembly instructions are included in the kit. However, we recommend using trained specialists if you prefer professional installation, as they have the required knowledge, experience, and specialized tools. The heavy tempered glass door (approximately 220 lbs) typically requires a third person for safe handling. What are the electrical requirements, and do I need a professional electrician? The Viva 120 requires a 220–240V hardwired electrical connection with a dedicated breaker installed by a licensed electrician (heaters and electrical accessories sold separately). Exact amperage and wire size requirements depend on your chosen heater model (4.5–6kW recommended). We strongly recommend consulting with a qualified electrician to confirm proper installation, circuit capacity, and local electrical code compliance before purchasing a heater. Improper installation can affect performance and safety. What size heater should I choose, and does it come with the sauna? The Viva 120 is compatible with electric heaters in the 4.5–6kW range. Heaters are not included with the standard kit and are sold as optional add-ons. The compact steam room volume (2.7 m³) means smaller, efficient heaters are ideal. Choose based on your desired heat intensity and how quickly you want to reach temperature. Wood-burning heaters are not compatible with this model. Consult with a sauna specialist to select the best heater for your specific wellness goals and electrical setup. What maintenance does the sauna require, and how often should I perform it? The Viva 120 is low-maintenance but benefits from annual care. Externally, apply a UV-protective varnish to the ThermoWood® to preserve color and durability against sun exposure. Internally, treat benches and surfaces with specialized sauna oil or wax to maintain a smooth finish and protect wood. Drainage systems (built-in floor drains with slight floor incline) should be checked periodically to ensure water flows freely. Regular maintenance significantly extends sauna lifespan and keeps it looking beautiful year after year. Is the Viva 120 suitable for commercial or multi-user use, or just residential? The Viva 120 is designed for residential, personal use—it's a 1-person sauna. It's ideal for solo relaxation, daily recovery, or intimate couples' sessions. If you're considering commercial or frequent multi-user applications, warranty terms differ, and you should contact Leil directly to discuss specifications and coverage. For commercial wellness centers or spa facilities, Leil offers larger multi-person models better suited to high-use environments with appropriate warranty provisions. What does the 2-year warranty cover, and what's not covered? The 2-year warranty covers manufacturing defects in materials and labor, plus any damage occurring before transportation. It does not cover natural wood variations (color changes, knots, cracks), normal wear and tear from use, damage from incorrect assembly or installation, damage from natural disasters or force majeure events, or unauthorized modifications. Claims should be filed by emailing info@wcsaunas.com with photographs of damage taken immediately upon delivery or discovery. Claims must be reported within 72 hours of identifying concealed damage to qualify for replacement. Can I customize the Viva 120, and what upgrade options are available? Yes, the Viva 120 is customization-ready. Available upgrades include optional LED lighting sets for under-bench and/or behind-backrest illumination to create ambiance, and decorative hexagon back-wall panels for enhanced aesthetics. Additional customization is possible but requires 2–3 months minimum for design and manufacturing. Custom options may include front wall variations or layout modifications. Contact Leil or an authorized dealer to discuss your specific customization preferences and timeline. What certifications and standards does the Viva 120 meet? All Leil Saunas, including the Viva 120, are manufactured using materials that are certified and fully compliant with EU standards. The sauna reflects over 16 years of design refinement and engineering precision, recognized internationally with the 2024 Red Dot: Best of the Best design award—reflecting both aesthetic quality and practical performance. Components are sourced from premium suppliers meeting stringent environmental and safety standards, ensuring durability, safety, and environmental responsibility.
